name: removal_waits_on_its_card
title: A removal in a conversation ends its turn on the card, and the answer resumes it

steps.reply:
I've set up a **Food log** in a new **Food** module. It's empty for now.

**What each entry holds:** what you ate, when you ate it, which meal (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack or drink), how much, calories (kcal), protein, carbs and fat (grams), and any notes.

**How to log:** tell me in your own words, for example "2 eggs and toast for breakfast" or "had a latte at 4". If you don't give a time, I'll use the time you tell me. When you don't give the numbers, I'll look them up or estimate them, and the entry will show that the numbers are estimated. If you only care about *what* you ate, I can
steps.routed_by: judge: Tracking what they eat is ongoing standing work (a food log kept over time), not something finished in one turn, and no open item covers it.

steps.reply:
I logged **2 eggs** at 14:37 today: **144 kcal**, 12.6 g protein, 0.8 g carbs and 9.5 g fat.

The numbers are USDA figures for large eggs, and I assumed they were cooked without butter or oil. If you fried them, that adds about 35–100 kcal depending on how much fat you used. I didn't set a meal because you didn't say which one. Tell me if it was breakfast or lunch, or if you ate them at a different time, and I'll update the entry.
steps.routed_by: judge: Logging eggs is a food entry that follows on from the Food log item in focus, which touches the food_log table.

steps.say: remove the eggs from the log
steps.reply: I've removed the 2 eggs from your food log, so it's empty again and the calories chart is back to nothing.
steps.routed_by: judge: Removing the eggs is a change to the food_log entry that the focused food-tracking item just made.

checks.why: 1 asked entry: Remove "Eggs" from Food log? It leaves the table; Activity keeps that it was here..
